speaker: abel_garnish
text: I brought ink, in case any of this is to be copied.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Put the ink by, Abel. This is not a reading.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Not a reading. Then what are we doing with a morning?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A trial of some pages, on the men who will speak them, before I go into the country.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: So I copy nothing.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nothing. If a page will not stand in a mouth, I do not want it fair.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Which pages have you been hiding in that bundle?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The street. Mab. The feast. Half a play, honestly named.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: The street we have had already. Do you mean to hear the anger again?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Once, and short. The first anger, and then stop.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: It holds. The anger is not where thou art doubtful.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No. Mab next. Two lines of her, and I will read them.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: In shape no bigger then an Agot stone, on the forefinger of an Alderman.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: A thing that size, and still she crowds a room.

speaker: will_kemp
text: No song in her. A speech that small does not want a catch.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No song. She is Augustine's when he is in the room. He is not.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Two lines are a thin breakfast.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two lines will tell you if you can see her. I think you can.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: I see the alderman's finger clearer than the dream. That may be the right way about.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: And still nothing for me to write fair?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Still nothing. The feast is the part that will not settle, and we are not at her entrance.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Then I wait, master.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Wait, Nick. Thou dost not speak her till I ask what she knows.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I have a napkin and a joint-stool whenever you are done with the little midwife.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Keep them. You are not on till the room will not clear.
